scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/web && (npm run lint --workspace=apps/api 2>/dev/null || echo "API lint skipped (no lint script)")
scripts.lint:changed: bash -c 'web_changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD | grep -E "\.(ts|tsx)$" | grep "^apps/web/" || true); web_staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E "\.(ts|tsx)$" | grep "^apps/web/" || true); api_changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD | grep -E "\.(ts|js)$" | grep "^apps/api/" || true); api_staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E "\.(ts|js)$" | grep "^apps/api/" || true); if [ -n "$web_changed" ] || [ -n "$web_staged" ]; then cd apps/web && npm run lint; fi; if [ -n "$api_changed" ] || [ -n "$api_staged" ]; then (cd apps/api && npm run lint 2>/dev/null || echo "API lint skipped"); fi; if [ -z "$web_changed" ] && [ -z "$web_staged" ] && [ -z "$api_changed" ] && [ -z "$api_staged" ]; then echo "No TypeScript/JavaScript files changed"; fi'
scripts.tsc: npm run type-check --workspace=apps/web && (npm run type-check --workspace=apps/api 2>/dev/null || echo "API type-check skipped (no script)")
scripts.tsc:changed: bash -c 'web_changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD | grep -E "\.(ts|tsx)$" | grep "^apps/web/" || true); web_staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E "\.(ts|tsx)$" | grep "^apps/web/" || true); api_changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD | grep -E "\.(ts|js)$" | grep "^apps/api/" || true); api_staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E "\.(ts|js)$" | grep "^apps/api/" || true); if [ -n "$web_changed" ] || [ -n "$web_staged" ]; then cd apps/web && npm run type-check; fi; if [ -n "$api_changed" ] || [ -n "$api_staged" ]; then (cd apps/api && npm run type-check 2>/dev/null || echo "API type-check skipped"); fi; if [ -z "$web_changed" ] && [ -z "$web_staged" ] && [ -z "$api_changed" ] && [ -z "$api_staged" ]; then echo "No TypeScript/JavaScript files changed"; fi'
scripts.check:all: npm run lint && npm run tsc
scripts.check:changed: npm run lint:changed && npm run tsc:changed
